en: A sepia-toned, vintage photograph showing a large group of men, women, and children posing in an outdoor setting under trees. Most individuals are dressed in early 20th-century European attire, with several women wearing headscarves. There are flags and banners being held, and a uniformed man is visible on the left, possibly military or police. The backdrop features a wooden house with a balcony and a tiled roof, typical of Central or Eastern European architecture.
